back: Falls in average (unit) cost as a business increases its scale of operation.
Rises in average cost when a business grows too large.
Purchasing (bulk discounts), marketing (spread over more sales), financial (cheaper loans), managerial (specialists), technical (better machinery).
Poor communication, low commitment of employees, weak coordination, lack of control.
Decentralise, improve communication, motivate and involve staff, set clear objectives.
Economies of scale lower average cost; total cost still rises with output.
A larger machine may cost twice as much but produce four times as much, halving cost per unit.
Large firms are less risky to lenders, so they borrow more easily and at lower interest; plcs can sell shares.
